Players Committee card image of [[Droideka (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Permanent weapon is Twin Blaster Cannons (may target a character or vehicle; draw destiny; add 2 if targeting a vehicle; if total destiny > defense value, target hit and you may activate 1 Force). While with another [Presence] droid at a site, adds one battle destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/droideka.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 ab74419] (31 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
